STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are 20-30 cm. The plate looks medium-large relative to the food, so I estimate about 26 cm.
b) Reference: the plate spans roughly 430 px across the frame, and the food mound is about 260 px wide. There is no fork or utensil in view, so I cannot use a known-length object. I rely on the plate type cue.
Final width: 26 cm, so area = 26 x 26 = 676 cm².

- Cooked leafy greens (basil or similar herb, with some dark leaves): footprint about 4% of the plate, roughly 27 cm². Thickness about 0.8 cm. Volume = 22 ml. Density 0.6 gives about 13 g.
- Rice or grains mixed through the dish (visible tan grains between the meat): base layer about 5% of the plate, roughly 34 cm², thickness about 0.5 cm. Volume = 17 ml. Density 0.8 gives about 14 g.
- Sauce (glossy, thin coating on the meat): footprint roughly the same as the meat, thickness 0.1-0.2 cm. Estimate about 8 g.
- Red chilli slices: small, about 3 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: Rice and greens are partly under the meat, already counted as a base layer above. The plate is not heaped, so no large hidden mass is added.

- Stir-fried beef: about 220 kcal/100 g (lean beef with some fat).
- Cooked greens: about 35 kcal/100 g.
- Cooked rice: about 130 kcal/100 g.
- Sauce (oil-based stir-fry sauce): about 90 kcal/100 g.

Totals: beef 97 g, greens 13 g, rice 14 g, sauce 8 g, chilli 3 g. Total about 135 g. Energy: beef 213 + greens 5 + rice 18 + sauce 7 + chilli 1 ≈ 244 kcal.
